cases.A: new event -> coverage updated -> snapshot no change
cases.B: new event changes deterministic snapshot field -> candidate -> validator pass -> auto activate
cases.C: new event touches analytical snapshot field -> review_required -> no auto activation
cases.D: new event published but coverage rebuild fails -> facts stay -> old coverage stays -> refresh failed
cases.E: coverage succeeds, snapshot staging fails -> coverage retained -> active snapshot unchanged
cases.F: snapshot commit interrupted -> journal detected -> recovery -> exactly one active
cases.J: duplicate consumption of same refresh request -> no duplicate coverage/snapshot
cases.L: refresh request after publication rollback -> consumption rejected
